long_biography.plain_text:
William “Bill” Loughborough was a mortgage entrepreneur when he agreed to combine HomeLoan.com with a Loraca subsidiary in 2000. As a founder and owner, he took part in a transaction that exchanged HomeLoan shares for stock in the acquiring company. His earlier businesses included Landmark Mortgage and National Mortgage Research Company.

His subsequent move into debt settlement brought regulatory difficulties. In 2013, he and CreditAnswers agreed to a Colorado settlement over alleged failures to comply with consumer-protection requirements. The agreement permanently barred them from providing debt-management services to Colorado residents. He also served as chairman and chief executive of AutoAssure, a seller of vehicle service contracts. That company was later acquired by Endurance.
